label: Foundation, accompaniment and a coexisting term do not give concurrent actualization
paraphrase: Closed result, attribution deferred: it is not the case that, for every history over a preordered time, giving relation, origin relation and reception predicate, foundation of the origin relation on received esse, irreflexivity (no thing related to itself), non-mutuality (the term not related back to the bearer), accompaniment, coexistence of the term and received onset being given (fa3e228b) together entail weak concurrent actualization 40a97664. Witness: Control part 1, in which a creator is present at every moment and gives a received-esse thing being at its first moment only, and the thing keeps its relation to the creator afterwards. So the structural features typed from ST I q.13 a.7 (an existing term, no relation of a thing to itself, real in one extreme only), whose warrant is independent of 40a97664, do not reach giving at the moment. Not shown: that giving by the term is the minimal addition that would.
